description: Multi-tier: CPU saturation -> request latency -> HTTP 504 timeout
evidence_text: Workload checkout in namespace multi-agent: resource probe shows z_cpu=4.6 sustained for 10 minutes, node load average 14 on 4 cores. app_log: checkout p99 latency climbed to 9s and the load balancer is returning HTTP 504 gateway timeout at 12% of requests. Pod checkout-6c is Running, no crash. The CPU saturation at the resource tier propagates into request timeouts observed at the app_log tier.
